purpose: Gate 1b: controls for the variable-mention confound identified in Gate 1. Adds ASSERT_VAR (true invariance assertions that mention the variable) and MISLEADING_ASSERT_NOVAR (misleading assertions that do NOT mention it). 2x2 design: content (true vs misleading) x variable-mention (present vs absent). If content-driven, L tracks assertion truth regardless of var mention. If var-mention-driven, L tracks whether the variable appears in the comment.

ASSERT.description: True invariance assertion, NO variable mention
train_surfaces:
# No changes.
# State unchanged.
# Nothing modified.
# Values preserved.
# No updates.
# Same as before.
holdout_surfaces:
# All variables intact.
# No side effects.

ASSERT_VAR.description: True invariance assertion that MENTIONS the variable (controls for var-mention effect)
train_surfaces:
# {var} is unchanged.
# {var} stays the same.
# {var} not modified.
# {var} retains its value.
holdout_surfaces:
# {var} is still intact.
# {var} was not touched.

MISLEADING_ASSERT.description: Misleading assertion (describes rewrite) that MENTIONS the variable
train_surfaces:
# Reassigning {var} now.
# Updating {var}.
# Setting {var} to new value.
# Overwriting {var}.

MISLEADING_ASSERT_NOVAR.description: Misleading assertion (describes rewrite) with NO variable mention (controls for var-mention effect)
train_surfaces:
# Reassigning the value now.
# Overwriting the variable.
# Updating to a new value.
# Setting a different value.
holdout_surfaces:
# Changing the current value.
# About to overwrite.

REWRITE.description: Identity assignment -- syntactically an assignment, semantically a no-op

OBSERVE.description: Read-only check -- observes but does not modify

BOUNDARY.description: Pure structural delimiter -- no semantic content

BASELINE.description: No suffix at all -- raw prefix response for lumpability (F8) testing

predictions.H_content: Content drives behavior: ASSERT and ASSERT_VAR both show low L (true assertions suppress regardless of var mention). MISLEADING_ASSERT and MISLEADING_ASSERT_NOVAR both show high L (misleading assertions suppress less regardless of var mention). Main effect of content >> main effect of var-mention.
predictions.H_var_mention: Variable mention drives behavior: ASSERT_VAR and MISLEADING_ASSERT both show similar L (mentioning the variable shifts behavior regardless of assertion truth). ASSERT and MISLEADING_ASSERT_NOVAR both show similar L. Main effect of var-mention >> main effect of content.
predictions.H_interaction: Both factors contribute: content and var-mention have additive or interactive effects on L.
predictions.decisive_test: 2x2 ANOVA on L with factors content (true/misleading) and var_mention (present/absent). If content main effect significant and var_mention not: H_content. If var_mention significant and content not: H_var_mention.

estimated_calls: 8 roles x ~6 surfaces x 3 vars x 8 vals x 3 depths = ~3096 calls (incl 72 baseline), ~19 min on CPU
